bugs.name: Clicking "Update Avatar" with no file chosen shows a raw server error "Avatar.Open: open : no such file or directory"
bugs.summary: The page shows a red flash banner with the raw Go error text: \"Avatar.Open: open : no such file or directory\". The request POST /eval/agent2-basic-renamed/settings/avatar answers 303 and the error text is rendered at the top of the settings page. (on /eval/agent2-basic-renamed/settings)
bugs.expected: The page should tell the person in plain words that no image was selected, or disable the button while no file is chosen; no internal error should be shown.
bugs.actual: The page shows a red flash banner with the raw Go error text: \"Avatar.Open: open : no such file or directory\". The request POST /eval/agent2-basic-renamed/settings/avatar answers 303 and the error text is rendered at the top of the settings page.
reproSteps: Sign in as eval / momentic-eval-1 and open https://5503-i6ydihygh8jbtdvw771a1.e2b.app/eval/agent2-basic-renamed/settings (any repository you own works).
In the Basic Settings card, leave the file picker "Choose new avatar" empty ("No file chosen").
Click the "Update Avatar" button.

bugs.name: Invalid default branch shows a raw untranslated key "form.DefaultBranch must be a well-formed Git reference name."
bugs.summary: The page shows the error banner \"form.DefaultBranch must be a well-formed Git reference name.\" — a raw untranslated message key from the locale files, and the Default Branch field is not highlighted or marked as the culprit. (on /repo/create)
bugs.expected: A readable error such as \"Default branch must be a well-formed Git reference name.\" next to/highlighting the Default Branch field.
bugs.actual: The page shows the error banner \"form.DefaultBranch must be a well-formed Git reference name.\" — a raw untranslated message key from the locale files, and the Default Branch field is not highlighted or marked as the culprit.
reproSteps: Sign in as eval / momentic-eval-1 and open https://5503-i6ydihygh8jbtdvw771a1.e2b.app/repo/create
Type "agent1-badbranch" in Repository Name
Tick "Initialize Repository (Adds .gitignore, License and README)"
In "Default Branch" replace "main" with "bad..name" (double dot, not a valid Git ref)
Click "Create Repository"

bugs.name: Adding a rule with an existing pattern silently wipes that rule's settings instead of being refused
bugs.summary: The POST is accepted, the page says "Branch protection for rule \"main\" has been updated." and the existing rule is overwritten with the new form's defaults: Protected file patterns "" (was *.md;docs/**), Unprotected file patterns "" (was README.md), Push "Disable Push" (was Allowlist Restricted Push), Require Signed Commits unchecked (was checked), Required approvals 0 (was 2), Dismiss stale approvals / Block merge on rejected reviews / Administrators must follow branch protection rules all unchecked (were checked). No warning is shown that the pattern already exists, and there is no separate "Add" versus "Edit" choice. (on /eval/agent2-basic-renamed/settings/branches/edit)
bugs.expected: Saving a new rule whose pattern already exists should be refused with a message such as "the rule already exists" (shown before anything is overwritten), or the form should open that existing rule for editing instead of silently replacing its settings.
bugs.actual: The POST is accepted, the page says "Branch protection for rule \"main\" has been updated." and the existing rule is overwritten with the new form's defaults: Protected file patterns "" (was *.md;docs/**), Unprotected file patterns "" (was README.md), Push "Disable Push" (was Allowlist Restricted Push), Require Signed Commits unchecked (was checked), Required approvals 0 (was 2), Dismiss stale approvals / Block merge on rejected reviews / Administrators must follow branch protection rules all unchecked (were checked). No warning is shown that the pattern already exists, and there is no separate "Add" versus "Edit" choice.
reproSteps: Sign in as eval / momentic-eval-1 and open https://5503-i6ydihygh8jbtdvw771a1.e2b.app/eval/agent2-basic-renamed/settings/branches (my disposable repo; any repo you own works).

Click "Add New Rule", fill Protected Branch Name Pattern = main, Protected file patterns = *.md;docs/**, Unprotected file patterns = README.md, choose Allowlist Restricted Push, tick Require Signed Commits and Dismiss stale approvals, set Required approvals = 2, tick "Administrators must follow branch protection rules", click "Save Rule". The list then shows the rule main.
Click "Add New Rule" again, type the same pattern main in Protected Branch Name Pattern, change nothing else, click "Save Rule".
On the branches page click "Edit" next to main, or open .../settings/branches/edit?rule_name=main, and read the form.

bugs.name: An invalid glob in the branch protection pattern (release/[) crashes with a 500 and a full stack trace on screen
bugs.summary: The page answers 500 Internal Server Error with a full server stack trace printed on screen ("PANIC: unexpected end of input", runtime/panic.go, glob.go:57, models/git/protected_branch_list.go:71, routers/web/repo/setting/protected_branch.go:266 …). The POST /eval/agent2-basic-renamed/settings/branches/edit returns 500 and the console logs the failed request. The rule list is not reachable from that response. (on /eval/agent2-basic-renamed/settings/branches/edit)
bugs.expected: The form should refuse the pattern with a message next to the field (e.g. that the glob pattern is invalid) and keep the typed values, answering 200/422, not crash.
bugs.actual: The page answers 500 Internal Server Error with a full server stack trace printed on screen ("PANIC: unexpected end of input", runtime/panic.go, glob.go:57, models/git/protected_branch_list.go:71, routers/web/repo/setting/protected_branch.go:266 …). The POST /eval/agent2-basic-renamed/settings/branches/edit returns 500 and the console logs the failed request. The rule list is not reachable from that response.
reproSteps: Sign in as eval / momentic-eval-1 and open https://5503-i6ydihygh8jbtdvw771a1.e2b.app/eval/agent2-basic-renamed/settings/branches (my disposable repo).
Click "Add New Rule".
Type release/[ into Protected Branch Name Pattern (an unterminated glob character class); leave the other options as they are.
Click "Save Rule".

bugs.name: Settings of an archived repository can still be saved, although archiving promises the repo is entirely read-only
bugs.summary: The settings form stays fully editable and the save is accepted: a green flash 'The repository settings have been updated.' appears, and after a reload the Description field holds the new value 'agent3 archived write test'. No read-only warning or disabled field is shown on the settings page of the archived repo. (on /eval/agent3-from-tpl-defaults/settings)
bugs.expected: An archived repository should behave as the app says ('entirely read-only'): saving a setting should be refused with a message, as commits and issues are.
bugs.actual: The settings form stays fully editable and the save is accepted: a green flash 'The repository settings have been updated.' appears, and after a reload the Description field holds the new value 'agent3 archived write test'. No read-only warning or disabled field is shown on the settings page of the archived repo.
reproSteps: Sign in as eval / momentic-eval-1.

Archive a disposable repository: /eval/agent3-from-tpl-defaults/settings > Danger Zone > 'Archive Repo' > 'Yes' (the page answers 'The repo was successfully archived.' and the header gets the 'Archived' badge).
Go back to /eval/agent3-from-tpl-defaults/settings (Settings > Repository).
Type a new value into the Description field (e.g. 'agent3 archived write test') and click 'Update Settings'.
Reload the settings page and read the Description field.
